description: Chandigarh University, Uttar Pradesh Launches AI Ethics Training Programme; 1.5 Lakh Youth to be Trained in next 5 years Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India (NewsVoir)
body_lead: Chandigarh University, Uttar Pradesh Launches AI Ethics Training Programme; 1.5 Lakh Youth to be Trained in next 5 years Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India (NewsVoir) Chandigarh University Uttar Pradesh, the country’s first private AI-augmented multidisciplinary university located in Unnao, Uttar Pradesh, has taken a significant step in the healthcare sector by officially launching the Centre of Excellence in Smart Healthcare to support and strengthen the UP-state vision of AI in healthcare.
